definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: Admissibility consists of strong boundary necks, late canonical control outside the interior retained set at nonempty events, and late canonical control everywhere at vanishing events. It does not define initial normalization or compactness.

PartialStandardCapFlow requires positive lifetime, Ricci flow, initial metric and connection identities, and a uniform global full-curvature bound on each compact included time interval. Completeness and rotational invariance are derived.
The cap cylinder is 2(1-t)g_unitS2+ds^2, with scalar 1/(1-t). Asymptotic charts are fixed spatial charts over each compact time interval; jets are spatial, not unasserted mixed time derivatives.
Standard-flow noncollapse has r<=rStar, r^2<=t, a curvature bound on the fixed final-time ball throughout (t-r^2,t], and conclusion vol>=kappaStar*r^3.

M35 scalar lower rate is independent of the final extra-time canonical alternative. The guarded derivative inequality is used only above H. Common-domain uniqueness uses finite weighted annular energies, not a DeTurck gauge.

M36 chooses q,C0,R0,delta0 before the manifold/neck, and comparison_delta after eta. The pinching logarithm has the nu>0 guard. The collapse is continuous on the neck carrier and its target ambient distance is bounded by input intrinsic neck distance.

M33 terminal input has time domain [0,T), T>0, last regular slab, arbitrarily late curvature blowup, admissible/pinched/canonical/noncollapsed assumptions, and all displayed rho/height bounds. The bridge preserves the exact regular limit, core image and selected height.

M38 threshold is chosen before the admissible raw flow and uses terminalAccuracyFactor*epsilon<=epsilon0 with factor 10^14. Integration corrected the author's factor 2 against ConnectedSum/Surgery/LocalTheory.lean; the local construction returns actual assemblies rather than assuming classified discarded pieces.

M39 needs actual selected parent/child components and pullback metrics, separating spheres, nonempty full retained open region, strict delta/height bounds and calibrated accuracy. A single fixed map precedes eta; only the late time window changes.

M40 chooses the child orientation by inverse transport through actual H3(Phi). Its homotopy equivalence has Phi as forward map. Smooth approximants have the same target basepoint and the same based pi3 map.

M44 fixed scales permit r(t) to vary but require rNext<=r(t), delta(t)<=deltaBar and exact h selector. The selected standard flow is identical to the observation's. Both persistence alternatives include comparison on the whole assigned half-open time interval, and removal is of the whole physical birth ball.
